_meta.title: Clash Front canonical zone registry
_meta.purpose: Generator + sim input. The base pass reads biomeFamily/palettes/primaryElements (biome derives from zone+position); the seed pass reads family/strengthMultiplier/zoneAvgStrength (wild sizing). CF main session reads zoneId + zoneAvgStrength + family/multiplier.
_meta.author: Map-maker session, 2026-07-07
_meta.grounding: docs/maps/CONTINENT-TERRAIN-ATLAS.md (identity/biome/counts), docs/maps/ZONE-BIOME-SEEDING-GUIDANCE.md (materials), docs/maps/BIOME-RECRUITMENT-AND-ARMY.md (elements). Parcel counts + worldOffset are the real extracted data (data/hexagon-city-source).
_meta.parcelIdEncoding: 6 + zoneCode(2) + parentIndex(4) + subIndex(4)  => zoneCode is chars[1..3] of a parcelId; look up zone by zoneCode.

strengthModel.note: zoneAvgStrength = baseline * strengthMultiplier. Relative index; the seed pass scales real wild-garrison size from it. Numbers are a grounded proposal — owner to tune, then freeze.

charScale._note: THE DIMINUTION (owner 2026-07-10, Hunt lore): the deep diminishes CHARACTERS, not the world. Same ±161 arena, zero extra geometry — smaller character + proportionally lower camera = the world READS bigger (structures become massive; the land only SEEMS vast). TWO KNOBS: 'visual' (model+camera scale — carries the LORE numbers, locked: UW2 1/1.5 = uncanny 'something is weird'; UW3 1/6 = the deception, the number is 6 on purpose) and 'kinematic' (move speed/ranges — ⚙ tuned for feel; full 1/6 speed would be unplayable, √6≈1/2.45 reads vast but playable). Terrain/structures/arena bounds/unit counts/stats UNCHANGED. Spec: docs/briefs/DIMINUTION-SCALE-SPEC.md

zoneLinks._note: Inter-zone travel — OWNER-LOCKED 2026-07-11. SKY: Aeropolis (HS1) = the GATE TO HEAVEN. ALL surface airships (Arcadia, Porthaven) land at HS1 FIRST, then BRANCH to ONE of HS2 (Emberfall) or HS3 (Empyrea) — the two are AT WAR (skyWar) and have NO direct link; you reach each only through HS1 and pick a side at the gate. Empyrea (HS3) = the rightful pinnacle; Emberfall (HS2) = the fallen-angel usurper. Mirror-with-variation of the underworld's LINEAR descent (Shaft) HUB→UW1→UW2→UW3 (owner: 'intentional variation of UW rules'). Agent D records; Agent C wires world.js to read routes straight from here. Full spec: docs/maps/OVERWORLD-CONNECTIONS.md.

skyWar.lore: The War of the Sky Throne: Emberfall (HS2) = the FALLEN ANGELS (Ember-fall), UW-corrupted, returned to heaven to claim the throne — besieging Empyrea (HS3), the rightful pinnacle.
